panels.text: Savitaben ને WhatsApp પર message આવ્યો: 'KBC માં ₹25 લાખ જીત્યા!'
Message: 'Congratulations! You won ₹25,00,000. Claim now. Send ₹500 registration fee.'
redFlags: Real lottery ક્યારેય registration fee નથી લેતી
WhatsApp message — official lottery notification નહીં

panels.question: Savitaben શું કરે?
panels.correct: Message delete કરો, family ને બતાવો

panels.rightOutcome: ✅ Savitaben એ message delete કર્યો → safe! 🎉

panels.subtext: જો ઇનામ લેવા માટે પૈસા ભરવા પડે — તો તે 100% ઠગ છે.

panels.text: Savitaben received a WhatsApp message: 'You won ₹25 lakh in KBC!'
Message: 'Congratulations! You won ₹25,00,000. Claim now. Send ₹500 registration fee.'
redFlags: Real lotteries never charge a registration fee
WhatsApp message — not an official lottery notification

panels.question: What should Savitaben do?
panels.correct: Delete the message and tell a family member

panels.rightOutcome: ✅ Savitaben deleted the message → stayed safe! 🎉

panels.rule: Real prizes never ask for a 'fee'.
panels.subtext: If you have to pay money to receive a prize — it is 100% a scam.

quiz.gu: WhatsApp પર lottery message આવ્યો. Registration fee ₹500 માંગે. તમે?
quiz.en: A WhatsApp lottery message asks for a ₹500 registration fee. You:

explanation.en: Real lotteries never charge a fee.

quiz.gu: KBC / Jio lottery message WhatsApp પર — real છે?
quiz.en: A KBC / Jio lottery message on WhatsApp — is it real?

explanation.gu: Official lottery WhatsApp message નથી મોકલતી.
explanation.en: Official lotteries do not send WhatsApp messages.

quiz.gu: ઠગ 'ઇનામ' message માં સૌ પ્રથમ શું માંગે?
quiz.en: What do scammers ask for first in a 'prize' message?

explanation.gu: Small fee — પછી વધુ ને વધુ demand.
explanation.en: Small fee first — then bigger and bigger demands.
